name: ollama
title: Ollama (Standalone)
description: Run large language models locally: Gemma, Qwen, Llama, Mistral and hundreds more, with a REST API for any app. Pick this server's graphics card on the deploy sheet (AMD through ROCm, NVIDIA) to run models on it.

variables.name: PORT_OLLAMA
variables.label: API Port
variables.description: Port to expose Ollama API on

variables.name: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH
variables.label: Context length
variables.description: How much of a conversation a model keeps in mind, in tokens (8192 suits a 12 GB card; 16384 or more on 16 GB)
